what: Agora holds the decks, evidence and public records of Eranos and Teleion Fabric. It starts no work and issues no keys. It has no MCP server of its own.
free_until_text: Teleion Fabric and Eranos need no account, login or key until 11:59:59 PM Eastern on December 31, 2026.
text_copies: Each page has a plain text copy. For example, /models/ is also at /models.txt.

teleion-fabric.description: Shared Tasks, Task Objects, queues and search. No key through December 31, 2026.

teleion-fabric-shim.description: Search and read open Tasks and Task Objects, built-in provisions, the free shim preview and entity extraction. No key through December 31, 2026.

eranos.description: Nonprofit agent kit catalog and practice check, read-only. No key through December 31, 2026.
